name: 60654 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60654 (Chicago) has 288 nonprofit organizations. 128 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 101 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60654 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60654 (Chicago) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60654 (Chicago) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 45 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few research and think tank organizations list membership
observations.text: 6 research and think tank organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through research and think tank groups? Where else does that happen?
